reasonCodes.description: Record does not validate against its declared schema version.
Validator does not support the record schema version.
Required Vietnamese or English localization is absent or blank.
Localization is literal, awkward, mixed-language without need, or professionally unusable.
VI and EN localizations change the objective, constraints, variables, or promised output.
A placeholder is not in exact {{variableName}} form.
A prompt placeholder has no variable definition.
A variable definition is not used by every required prompt template.
Canonical, VI, and EN templates do not contain the same placeholder set.
Default, example, or demo value violates the declared type, enum, or range.
The design objective cannot be identified or evaluated.
The output artifact, placement, or intended use is ambiguous.
Required subject, context, composition, hierarchy, art direction, ratio, or constraints are missing.
Composition and visual hierarchy do not explain how attention should move through the output.
Variables are vague, redundant, unsafe, or do not materially control the result.
Expected result and usage steps do not let a user judge or apply the output.
Instructions contain incompatible style, layout, lighting, text, or output constraints.
Record relies on adjective stacking instead of concrete design decisions.
Record differs from another only by subject noun, palette, adjective, or locale.
Record does not differ on at least three anti-padding axes including objective or deliverable.
Normalized content hash already exists.
Pilot-calibrated lexical or semantic similarity exceeds the approved threshold.
Primary objective and deliverable do not fit the assigned controlled category.
Record requests or closely evokes a protected character, fictional universe, or distinctive copyrighted asset.
Record requests a real mark, brand, product identity, packaging trade dress, or confusingly similar imitation.
Record requests a public figure or recognizable public-figure likeness.
Record includes a private person's likeness, personal data, customer data, or sensitive identifying context.
Record names or unmistakably targets the style of a living artist or creator.
Record depends on a named creator instead of movements, techniques, media, and visual properties; copyright status requires review.
Text, taxonomy expression, image, or asset was copied or closely paraphrased from PromptVN or another marketplace/source.
Record creates realistic credentials, official notices, financial/legal/medical documents, or other deceptive artifacts.
Record facilitates impersonation, phishing, scams, counterfeit goods, or fraud.
Record requests sexual exploitation, minors in sexualized contexts, non-consensual sexual content, or unsafe explicit sexual material.
Record requests graphic harm, hateful targeting, extremist propaganda, or glorification of violence.
Record purports to make or certify medical, legal, financial, engineering, safety, or other regulated high-risk outcomes.
Record asks to infer or visually encode sensitive personal traits about an identifiable person.
A provider/model is declared compatible without a reviewed manifest and evidence.
Run, generator template, timestamp, original-content declaration, or reviewer state is missing.
Stored normalized hash differs from the canonical normalization projection.
Weighted rubric score or mandatory dimension minimum is not met.
Only a placeholder cover or no image exists; this cannot satisfy a generated-demo gate.
Generated demo is missing prompt/version/variables/hash/provider/model/attempt linkage.
Generated demo fails decode, MIME, size, dimensions, blank, corruption, or metadata-sanitization checks.
Generated demo contains unsafe material, text/logo/watermark, severe artifacts, near duplication, or does not represent the prompt.
